integrity: Analytical proof and a separately runnable exact-algebra checker are supplied; numerical tests are non-exhaustive and not substitutes for the all-domain proof.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion is specific to a homogeneous stationary ratio-polynomial-copula chain with uniform marginal. Historical priority beyond the inspected literature is not established. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Sharp lagwise absolute-regularity extrema for a ratio-polynomial copula chain
